parts.t: Delta Manor is an MLS® area in Ladner. This guide covers the school and parks in this part of Ladner.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 11, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate since 2015. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Delta.
This isn’t legal, planning or financial advice. Prior to buying or selling in Delta Manor, confirm the zoning, read what the community plan says and find out which schools cover the address.

parts.t: In 2024 Delta brought in a new Official Community Plan. What the zoning and the plan allow can vary from one lot to the next.
A single detached or duplex lot of up to 280 square metres can now hold 3 units in Delta, and a larger lot can hold 4. Those limits include secondary, coach and garden suites.
Delta’s dikes, seawalls and other shoreline protection stretch over 63 km, and upgrades are expected as sea levels rise.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Delta Manor

parts.t: Check with the City of Delta on the property’s zoning, and on what the plan says for that lot and its neighbours.
Use the Delta School District school locator for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report (a plan for the repairs ahead), the meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, and any special levies (one-time extra charges).
Walk from the home to Ladner Leisure Centre, City Hall and the bus stops to see how close they are on foot.
For a strata home, ask how many parking stalls come with the unit and what the bylaws say about visitor parking.
Check flood, drainage and ALR status.

Delta Manor is an MLS® area name in Ladner. The Delta Manor Education Centre is at 4750 57 Street.
Is there an official Delta Manor boundary?
The name Delta Manor comes from the real estate board’s MLS® sub-areas and is not an official municipal boundary. If you need a particular address checked, ask me.
Is the Delta Manor Education Centre a regular school?
No. It is listed by the district as a learning centre. Check the Delta School District school locator for the school that serves your address.
